criteria.assessment: Approved review coverage: both guides and the exact eight-section ID/order and outcome parity were inspected directly. The semantic verdict and any defects are recorded in review.md.
Approved review coverage: the opening, model, lifecycle walkthrough, evidence/recovery, adoption exercise, and close were inspected in both guides.
Approved review coverage: cue cards, presenter guidance, outcomes, and all eight internal timing entries were inspected; the totals were independently calculated as 90 minutes.

Approved review coverage: every evidence-inventory row and execution-status claim was inspected. The review found unique labels and explicit LIVE boundaries, while recording the invalid SAVED provenance in review.md.

Approved review coverage: every citation-inventory row was checked for path existence, passage description, and SUPPORTED decision, and all direct source citations in the guides were compared against the inventory. The omitted worktree and workflow-reference rows are recorded in review.md.
Approved review coverage: the seven required parity dimensions were compared across the English and Persian guides, including primary versus optional status, and each recorded MATCH was checked.
Approved review coverage: baseline and candidate physical wc -l counts, the 35 percent threshold, the preservation checklist, and the candidate commit file scope were independently checked.
